intro: Football is the most popular sport in Cyprus.

chapters.title: Football
text: APOEL Nicosia reached the quarter-finals of the Champions League in 2012, a remarkable run for a small club.

chapters.title: Olympics and tennis
text: Sailor Pavlos Kontides won Cyprus's first Olympic medal, a silver, in 2012, and tennis player Marcos Baghdatis reached the Australian Open final in 2006.

keyTerms.meaning: The round of the last eight in a competition.
